Name: (CP) SVE Trees of Simple Foliage
Author: Hitme11
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ff7700][b]All SVE Trees (Birch, Fir, Money Tree, Persimmon, Pear, Nectarine) have been done in 2.0.0 update!
[/b][/color]Please delete old files before update.[/size][/center]


Trees in Stardew Valley Expanded now matched the style of Simple Foliage. 

[size=3][color=#ff7700][b][u]If you don't like vanilla color:
[/u][/b][/color]﻿    - For VPR & Earthy recolor, please check out: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43691]SVE Trees of Simple Foliage for Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn(VPR) by 1oOwOo1 [/url]
    - For Starblue recolor, please check out: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36191]SVE Trees of Simple Foliage for Starblue by ShilohAreles[/url].[/size]
   [size=3]﻿ - For purple recolor, please check out: [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43218]Purple Foliage - A swampy and magical Simple Foliage Recolor by voidcultist666[/url].[/size]


[color=#ff7700][b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/color]
﻿- Download and install[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753] Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (hard requirement)
﻿- Download and extract (CP) Hitme's SVE-Simple Foliage into your Mods folder.
﻿- Optionally, also download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]SF - Unofficial Update to 1.6[/url] if you want all other vanilla trees to match this style, though it's not a hard requirement for this mod to work.
[b]﻿- In config, you can manual turn off individual trees or options (see images above).[/b]

[b][color=#ff7700][u]Note:[/u] [/color][/b]
[b]﻿- Although they're (closely) matched the SF style, these are not directly use any of their assets. [/b]I just tried my best to blend the Simple Foliage style and SVE original designs, but there will be some inconsistent between my style and SF's.
﻿- You can [b]use this mod separately without using SF or SF - Unofficial[/b], though I'm not really sure why.
﻿- Only [b]vanilla color is available[/b] right now, and there is no plan to add more recolor for this mod. But anyone is welcome to do so and upload as separated mods, you can also find the color palette I used within the mod folder, if it helps.

[b][color=#ff7700][u]Technical details:[/u][/color][/b]
﻿- This mod replaces both map assets and wild trees.
﻿- Assets loaded with this mod is blanketed with 'Default + 10' priority.
﻿- Overlay loaded with 'Default + 12' priority.
﻿- Might not work with SDV 1.5 or older.
﻿- Due to limitation of map tiles used, Fir trees as map asset have rounder shape than their wild counterparts.

[b][color=#ff7700][u]Compatibility:[/u][/color][/b]
[b]- [color=#00ff00]Compatible with most mods, SF and SF - Unofficial Update to 1.6 (tested)[/color][/b]
[b]﻿- [color=#ffd966]Recolor mods: playable, but there will be inconsistent in color.[/color][/b]
[color=#ff0000][b]﻿- Mods that specifically target the SVE's Fir and Birch assets (such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34880]Bog's SVE Trees Retexture[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28266]Desaturated Trees for SVE[/url]) : not entirely compatible unless you manually edit this mod.[/b][/color]

﻿-[s] [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]SF - Unofficial Update to 1.6[/url][s] also has built-in SVE supports for some fruit trees (namely Pear, Persimmon, Nectarine and Tree Coin), but they look weird right now. I may tackle them in the future if I ever had inspiration to do trees again, (hopefully).  [/s][b]DONE![/b]
[s]﻿- Flowers and tree blooms overlays (similiar to SF's bushes). [/s][b]DONE![/b]
[color=#ff7700][b]  ﻿Not high priority:[/b][/color]
[b]  [s][i]﻿- Testing out a few more ideas: birds and bird nests animation overlays, festival and map specific overlays, tree animations (something like [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3911?tab=files]Fippsie's Animated Trees[/url][/s][i][s]﻿), etc. [/s][color=#ff7700]Performance got affected too much, not really worth it.[/color][/i]
[i]  [s]﻿- Test out recolor compatibility.[/s] [color=#ff7700]Check the links above, people had already done various recolors of this mod![/color][/i][/b]
